items.difficulty_reason: Fully faithfulness of the extension-of-scalars functor along a quasi-isomorphism of dg algebras: recalls the dg-level adjunction between restriction and extension of scalars, checks on good representatives that the unit is a quasi-isomorphism by hypothesis on A -> B, and closes the equivalence of the derived categories via the adjoint-fully-faithful criterion and the kernel-zero lemma of Derived Categories. Retained author proof at lines 5512-5546.
